description: When is the next Employment Cost Index (ECI), the quarterly measure of US wage and benefit costs? Returns the next release date and time in US Eastern, UTC and your time zone (London by default), the quarter it covers, and the following scheduled ECI dates. Source: US Bureau of Labor Statistics ECI schedule page. Gives dates only, not the index values. (cost: 1 credit)

timezone.description: string, optional, IANA time zone for the local time fields (e.g. Europe/London, America/New_York, Asia/Tokyo), default Europe/London

name: next_eci_release
